result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source has no dedicated protocol-level version, generation, prior-state, If-Match, or conditional-update field for tasks/get, tasks/update, or tasks/cancel. GetTaskParams contains request metadata plus task_id; UpdateTaskParams contains request metadata, task_id, and input_responses; CancelTaskParams contains request metadata plus task_id. Task.last_updated_at is observational metadata, GetTaskResult returns DetailedTask, and update/cancel return empty complete acknowledgements. ServerHandler validates Tasks capability and forwards these params directly to get_task/update_task/cancel_task without adding a historical precondition. RequestMetaObject preserves arbitrary extension keys, so custom _meta can transport an application-owned expected-generation or stable-operation token, but stock rmcp does not enforce it as CAS. The smallest fencing seam is authenticated/bound custom _meta plus atomic persistent-store compare-and-update on task_id and generation, with external-effect idempotency/fencing still separate.
